verdict.rationale: LM Studio has an official download page offering the app and the headless llmster daemon, and a Windows user reports a 'simple install' with no Python environment setup. Users note it is closed source, so installation is through distributed builds rather than compiling. Missing for 10: first-party docs explicitly describing prebuilt installers/packages per OS (Windows/macOS/Linux formats), package-manager availability, and confirmation of solid Linux packaging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install using prebuilt binaries or packages instead of compiling from source

citations.quote: llmster is LM Studio's headless daemon for servers, cloud instances, and CI.
llmster is the headless version of LM Studio, no desktop app required.
its so easy to use, simple install
